issues.issue: The amount is whatever the Depositor calculates 'in accordance with the EMC's internal risk management process in respect of similar instruments', an undisclosed and undefined external standard.
The definition describes MERS acting as mortgagee rather than defining a loan, so the defined term 'MOM Loan' does not match its definiens as used in Section 2.01.
The Mortgage is defined as an instrument creating a 'first lien', yet the Mortgage Loan Schedule definition expressly contemplates second lien Mortgage Loans and their CLTV.

The definition preserves loans not in fact transferred where there is 'a breach of the representation contained in Section 2.03(b)(v)', but Section 2.03(b) is a single survival sentence containing no clause (v); the cross-reference has no referent.
The enumerated schedule fields are internally garbled — two different items are lettered '(aa)' and several are '[reserved]' — so what the Schedule must contain is uncertain.
Recoverability is fixed by the 'good faith judgment' of the Master Servicer or Servicer with no objective test, and the residual phrase 'or otherwise' leaves the sources of recovery open-ended.

After listing named offices the definition adds 'any other officer customarily performing functions similar to those performed by any of the above designated officers', a catch-all whose reach against the enumerated list is uncertain.

The 'Originator' is defined solely as the party 'set forth in the Mortgage Loan Schedule', but the Mortgage Loan Schedule definition's enumerated fields identify only '(ee) the related Seller' and contain no originator field, so the term has no source.

The final proviso excludes 'investments in units of money market funds pursuant to clause (v) above', but clause (v) is guaranteed reinvestment agreements and money market funds are clause (viii), so the carve-out points at the wrong item.
'Prepayment Assumption' is defined only by reference to the Prospectus Supplement, a document that is not part of this Agreement and is not attached as an exhibit.

The deduction is 'the sum of (a) the related Servicing Fee, (b) the Master Servicing Fee Rate and (c) the LPMI Fee', adding a rate to dollar amounts, and the opening clause ('the amount received from and including the 16th day ... if any, by which') is grammatically broken.

The closing words 'or any replacement policy therefor through the related Interest Accrual Period for such Class relating to a Distribution Date' are grammatically detached and refer to a 'Class' that has no role in a mortgage insurance policy.
Clause (e) picks up Substitution Adjustment Amounts 'pursuant to Section 2.03(d)', but Section 2.03 has only subsections (a) and (b) and places the Substitution Adjustment Amount in unlettered text.

The Purchase Price is defined only for loans repurchased 'pursuant to Section 2.02' or purchased under Section 4.21, yet Sections 2.03 and 2.05 require deposit of 'the Purchase Price' on repurchases for breach of representation, leaving those repurchases without a defined price.

Clause (iii) adds 'any costs and damages (if any) incurred by the Trust in connection with any violation of such Mortgage Loan of any predatory lending laws' and is joined by the broken connector 'plus and', leaving the measure of recovery uncertain.
